plan.notes: Source: official ASU Degree Search major map for 'Computer Science, BS' (program code ESCSEBS, Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering), 2024-2025 catalog year, General Studies Gold: https://degrees.asu.edu/major-map/ASU00/ESCSEBS/null/ALL/2024 . Transcription method: manual transcription of every term row (courses, credit hours, minimum grades) from the official major map page on 2026-09-30. Catalog year note: the 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 major maps were not yet published on ASU Degree Search ('Major Map Unavailable. Check back soon!' for /ALL/2025 and /ALL/2026 as of 2026-09-30); 2024-2025 is the most recent official term-by-term sequence. Term names use ASU's own 'Term N' numbering (the major map does not label seasons). General Studies Gold requirements (HUAD, SCIT, SOBE, AMIT, GCSI, CIVI, SUST) are modeled as choice:true student-choice slots; the OR-options in core courses (ENG composition, MAT 267/CSE 259, CSE 412/434/445, Upper Division Technical Electives, CSE 4** electives) are also choice slots with the alternatives named in the title and choice_note. Per-course prerequisites are NOT listed on the ASU major map, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty -- no prereqs invented; the official term ordering preserves ASU's prerequisite chain. Caveats: (a) if ENG 105 is taken, a three credit hour elective must also be taken prior to graduation (major map note); (b) Technical Electives follow the SCAI technical elective course lists ('Contact SCAI Advising'); (c) CSE 485/486 capstones carry the (L) literacy designation per major map.
